name: Tank Evolution Simulator (RELEASE)
desc:
🔴 Welcome to Tank Evolution Simulator!!! 🔴 

⬇️ RELEASE ⬇️ 

🔴 RUSH OF UPDATES TO COME🔴 
🌞 USE CODES: SUMMER, RELEASE

How to Play: 
🏃‍ Shoot down blocks for EXP 🏃‍ 
⚔️ Defeat players smaller than you ⚔️ 
🔼Upgrade your tank🔼

Mobile: Press the lock button on the bottom right to lock your camera and the auto shoot button to toggle auto shoot. Use bottom right joystick to aim if camera is unlocked.
PC: Press E to toggle auto shoot and aim with mouse

Important: All purchases are not permanent and last for 1 life.
